Definition: from the base of G4245; to be a senior, i.e. (by implication) act as a representative (figuratively, preacher):--be an ambassador.
BiblicalUsage: Presbeuo means to act as an ambassador, a representative sent by a king. Paul says we are ambassadors for Christ, as though God did beseech you by us, and again that he is an ambassador in bonds for the mystery of the gospel.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe an ambassador speaks for the King who sent him, and my words carry weight only as far as they carry his.
